title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for part:360020
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer. You told us that only multi-year volume agreements change prices, so we propose to commit 20,000 pc per year for 24 or 36 months, as set out in the attached term sheets.

Our current agreement ctr:4600070620 runs on 60 days payment, and we would like to keep that. Your scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 shows 302 ppm against your 150 ppm standard commitment. It also shows an on-time delivery rate of 85.0%. Both are below what this renewal should rest on.

Could you tell us whether a cheaper variant or packaging option exists? Your owner kindly offered to walk us through the calculation, and we would welcome that.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for part:360020
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month agreement and can accommodate your request to maintain the 60-day payment terms. In light of the extended contract duration and volume commitment, we can offer a revised price of €4.91 per unit.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €4.91 per unit. This alternative package offers a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our colleagues will address your questions regarding alternative packaging, and we look forward to scheduling a meeting to discuss the cost structure in detail. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – revised term sheets for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for agreeing to 60 days payment. Our firm commitment is 20,000 pc per year for 24 or 36 months, with either 90 or 60 days payment, as set out in the attached term sheets.

Our forecast fc:360020@2026-09 records a 4.2% increase in demand for this part, so this volume is growing.

The cost drivers you cited imply an increase below 1% on our current price of 4.39 EUR. Your offer of 4.91 EUR is about 12% higher.

Could you ask your authorised pricing team to review this? A 36-month term would give you the multi-year volume agreement you described. Is a cheaper packaging variant possible?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – revised term sheets for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have carefully reviewed your revised term sheets and the forecast data indicating a volume increase. As to the volume change data you cited, that does not change our position. While we appreciate the projected growth, it does not impact our calculation to allow for further price reductions.

Our updated offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306 renewal - 36-month commitment and lot size
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for sharing the saving options.

Our commitment is firm: 20,000 pc per year, for either 24 or 36 months, as set out in the attached term sheets. A 36-month term gives you the multi-year volume agreement you said changes prices.

For the lot size, we can take doubled lot sizes without a drawing change. Could that EUR 0.05 per unit be reflected in the price? Could the material grade option also be quoted separately for our engineering review?

If your account manager's authority is limited, we would appreciate an authorised pricing review.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306 renewal - 36-month commitment and lot size
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We are delighted to remain your trusted partner for high-quality components and comprehensive service. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We can accept the 36-month term with 90 days payment, for which our authorised price is €4.94 per unit. For our official Angebot, we are pleased to confirm a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This proposal remains valid for 7 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. We will gladly provide a separate quotation for the alternative material grade for your engineering department.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
